newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rebound in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rebound in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks posted a moderate rebound in early morning trade on Friday, after the key stock index shed more than 800 points over the past two days.
Brokers said that the index was supported by a rally on Wall Street and Nikkei futures in Chicago overnight.
At 0009 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average gained 111.10 points or 0.57 percent to trade at 19,681.77. Its March futures rose 50 points to 19,710.
But the rally may later fizzle, brokers said.
